tools.name: mofa_youtube
tools.description: Download a YouTube video OR accept a local audio file, then transcribe via local ASR. Returns markdown transcript with timestamps. For YouTube videos, keeps the video file for frame extraction. NOT for frame extraction — use `mofa_frame` for frame capture.

url.description: YouTube video URL (provide this OR audio_path)

audio_path.description: Path to a local audio file — MP3, WAV, M4A, etc. (provide this OR url)

language.description: ASR language hint: auto, en, zh, ja, etc.
